glm-5.3.description: ZhipuAI GLM 5.3 (fp8-native, zai-org/GLM-5.3) — the model used in every quickstart code sample on https://docs.neuralwatt.com/quickstart (curl, Python and Node.js all default to "glm-5.3"), so it is treated as Neuralwatt's own recommended default here. Roster metadata (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28) marks reasoning mandatory (default effort "max") and declares tools:true and json_mode:true, but neither claim was independently probed — this onboarding is fully credential-free, no POST request was made. json_mode is not backed by a documented `response_format` parameter anywhere in the chat-completions API reference (https://docs.neuralwatt.com/api-reference/inference/create-a-chat-completion, retrieved 2026-09-28), so capabilities.structuredOutput is left false rather than trusting the flag alone. limits.max_output_tokens is null for this model in the live roster — omitted here rather than invented; models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (4096) is a generic placeholder, not a Neuralwatt-stated ceiling for this model. Pricing per the same roster response: $1.45 / $4.50 per MTok input/output, $0.145 cached input.

glm-5.3-flash.description: ZhipuAI GLM 5.3 Flash — lighter/cheaper sibling of the default. Roster-listed only (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28); not itself exercised in any code sample; fallback. vision:true and max_output_tokens are as declared by the roster response — the latter is null there, so it is omitted rather than invented.

qwen-3.8-27b.description: Qwen 3.8 27B (Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8) — dense 27B VL model with native 262K context; the first entry in Neuralwatt's own /v1/models roster (GET, 2026-09-28) and one of the few catalog entries with a documented max_output_tokens ceiling (131,072) and image limits (max_images:20, max_images_total:200), so it is used as models.visionModel. Roster-listed and roster-priced only; fallback, not capability-probed (credential-free onboarding, no POST made).

qwen3.6-35b.description: Qwen 3.6 35B — roster-listed only (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28); not capability-probed; fallback. max_output_tokens is null in the roster response, so it is omitted here.

kimi-k2.7-code.description: MoonshotAI Kimi K2.7 Code (moonshotai/Kimi-K2.7-Code) — "quant-agnostic canonical name for the Kimi K2.7 Code family" per the roster's own description field (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28). Roster-listed and roster-priced only; not capability-probed; fallback. max_output_tokens is null in the roster response, so it is omitted here.

kimi-k3.description: MoonshotAI Kimi K3 — general-purpose sibling of the Code line, 1M context per the roster (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28). Roster-listed only; not capability-probed; fallback. max_output_tokens is null in the roster response, so it is omitted here.

deepseek-v4.1-flash.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — roster-listed with a documented max_output_tokens ceiling (393,216) and vision:true (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28). Not capability-probed; fallback.

gemma-4-31b.description: NVIDIA's Gemma 4 31B build (owned_by/provider "nvidia" per the roster, GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28) — the only catalog entry from that provider label. Roster-listed with a documented max_output_tokens ceiling (16,384); not capability-probed; fallback.

setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.neuralwatt.com/v1 ("Neuralwatt Cloud"), serving 21 hosted open-weight models across Qwen, MoonshotAI Kimi, ZhipuAI GLM, DeepSeek and an NVIDIA Gemma build, with per-request energy and cost reporting (SSE comment lines / X-Request-Cost-USD headers). New accounts start at a $0 balance; adding a payment method grants a $1.00 trial credit valid 30 days, then usage is pay-per-token. Not all models support tool calling per Neuralwatt's own tool-calling guide — check a given model's capabilities on the /v1/models roster before relying on it.
